mapper.select: select cast(s.id as char) supplierId,s.code,s.name,s.level,s.status,s.score, (select count(*) from po_purchase_order o join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id where o.supplier_id=s.id and o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope}) orderCount, (select coalesce(sum(o.total_amount),0) from po_purchase_order o join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id where o.supplier_id=s.id and o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope}) amount, (select min(q.valid_until) from sp_supplier_qualification q where q.supplier_id=s.id and q.status='VALID') nearestQualificationExpiry, (select round(avg(datediff(r.receipt_date,o.created_at)),1) from inv_receipt r join po_purchase_order o on o.id=r.purchase_order_id where o.supplier_id=s.id and r.deleted=0 and o.deleted=0) avgDeliveryDays, (select count(*) from po_purchase_order o where o.supplier_id=s.id and o.deleted=0 and o.status='CANCELLED') cancelledCount from sp_supplier s where s.id=#{supplierId} and s.deleted=0

select cast(m.id as char) materialId,m.code materialCode,m.name materialName,w.name warehouse, b.quantity,m.min_stock minStock, cast(greatest(m.min_stock-b.quantity,0) as decimal(18,2)) shortage, cast(coalesce((select sum(i.quantity-i.received_quantity) from po_purchase_order_item i join po_purchase_order o on o.id=i.purchase_order_id where i.material_id=m.id and i.deleted=0 and o.deleted=0 and o.status in ('APPROVED','PARTIALLY_RECEIVED')),0) as decimal(18,2)) inTransit from inv_balance b join md_material m on m.id=b.material_id join md_warehouse w on w.id=b.warehouse_id where b.deleted=0 and b.quantity<m.min_stock order by shortage desc

select d.name name,count(distinct o.id) orders, cast(coalesce(sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price),0) as decimal(18,2)) amount from po_purchase_order o join po_purchase_order_item i on i.purchase_order_id=o.id and i.deleted=0 join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id join sys_department d on d.id=u.department_id where o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope} group by d.name order by amount desc

select s.name name,count(distinct o.id) orders, cast(coalesce(sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price),0) as decimal(18,2)) amount from po_purchase_order o join po_purchase_order_item i on i.purchase_order_id=o.id and i.deleted=0 join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id join sp_supplier s on s.id=o.supplier_id where o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope} group by s.name order by amount desc

select c.name name,count(distinct o.id) orders, cast(coalesce(sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price),0) as decimal(18,2)) amount from po_purchase_order o join po_purchase_order_item i on i.purchase_order_id=o.id and i.deleted=0 join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id join md_material_category c on c.id=m.category_id where o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope} group by c.name order by amount desc

select date_format(o.created_at,'%Y-%m') name,count(distinct o.id) orders, cast(coalesce(sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price),0) as decimal(18,2)) amount from po_purchase_order o join po_purchase_order_item i on i.purchase_order_id=o.id and i.deleted=0 join sys_user u on u.id=o.purchaser_id where o.deleted=0 and o.status<>'CANCELLED' and year(o.created_at)=#{year} and ${scope} group by date_format(o.created_at,'%Y-%m') order by amount desc
